x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Forge developer CLI. Transparent, deterministic and idempotent.

options.name: --root
options.description: Repository root to inspect (default: current directory). [default: .]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what a mutating command would do without doing it.

commands.name: modules
commands.description: Inspect and validate module manifests (forge-module.json).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List modules in id order.

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Print the module dependency graph as 'module -> dependency' lines.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate the module graph: ids, dependencies, cycles, schema ownership.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the repository against Forge conventions.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audit evidence tooling.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify the hash chain of an audit export; non-zero exit on any break.

arguments.name: EXPORT_FILE
arguments.description: Path to a JSON Lines audit export (produced by AuditExporter).

commands.name: new
commands.description: Generate a new Forge solution from the reference template (ordinary source, idempotent).

options.name: --template
options.description: Starter template: api, modular, saas (see `forge templates list`). [default: modular]

options.name: --admin
options.description: Alias for --template saas (kept for v0.1 scripts; deprecated, ADR 22).

options.name: --with-api
options.description: With saas: also map the bearer-only Identity and Audit APIs (/api/identity, /api/audit). Implied by api.

commands.name: templates
commands.description: Starter templates for `forge new`.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List templates as 'name  description' lines.

commands.name: db
commands.description: Database operations, delegated to the solution's DbMigrator (the CLI itself stays EF-free).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show applied/pending migrations per module schema.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Apply pending migrations (with --dry-run: list them without applying).

commands.name: ui
commands.description: Attach or detach first-party module UI packages (ordinary source edits, idempotent).

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add the module's UI package reference and registration in the admin host.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module UI to add or remove: identity, audit, tenancy.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove the module's UI package reference and registration in the admin host.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module UI to add or remove: identity, audit, tenancy.

commands.name: api
commands.description: Attach or detach first-party module API packages (ordinary source edits, idempotent).

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add the module's API package reference and registration in the admin host.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module API to add or remove: identity, audit.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove the module's API package reference and registration in the admin host.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module API to add or remove: identity, audit.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Forge version tooling.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Compare the repository's pinned Forge package versions against this CLI (offline, deterministic).
